evidence.notes: The Id overload permanently removes a deleted local record and returns a successful result.
The List<Id> overload permanently removes deleted local records and returns successful results.
The object overload permanently removes a deleted local record and returns a successful result.
The list-of-objects overload permanently removes deleted local records and returns successful results.

source.content: Account idAccount = new Account(Name = 'Purge Id'); insert idAccount; Id idValue = idAccount.Id; delete idAccount; Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult idResult = Database.emptyRecycleBin(idValue); System.assert(idResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(idValue, idResult.getId()); List<Account> idRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :idValue ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(0, idRows.size()); Account listIdAccount = new Account(Name = 'Purge List Id'); insert listIdAccount; Id listIdValue = listIdAccount.Id; delete listIdAccount; List<Id> ids = new List<Id>{listIdValue}; List<Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult> listIdResults = Database.emptyRecycleBin(ids); System.assertEquals(1, listIdResults.size()); System.assert(listIdResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(listIdValue, listIdResults[0].getId()); List<Account> listIdRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :listIdValue ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(0, listIdRows.size()); Account objectAccount = new Account(Name = 'Purge Object'); insert objectAccount; Id objectValue = objectAccount.Id; delete objectAccount; Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult objectResult = Database.emptyRecycleBin(objectAccount); System.assert(objectResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(objectValue, objectResult.getId()); List<Account> objectRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :objectValue ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(0, objectRows.size()); Account listObjectAccount = new Account(Name = 'Purge List Object'); insert listObjectAccount; Id listObjectValue = listObjectAccount.Id; delete listObjectAccount; List<SObject> objects = new List<SObject>{listObjectAccount}; List<Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult> listObjectResults = Database.emptyRecycleBin(objects); System.assertEquals(1, listObjectResults.size()); System.assert(listObjectResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(listObjectValue, listObjectResults[0].getId()); List<Account> listObjectRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :listObjectValue ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(0, listObjectRows.size());
